product.description: The Velora Velvet Shear Brush delivers a gentle, precision grooming experience for dogs of all sizes. Its ultra‑soft silk fibers glide through fur, reducing tangles while the ergonomic polypropylene handle provides a secure grip. Designed for use on short‑haired and medium‑coated breeds, the brush features a 25‑cm length and a lightweight 150‑gram construction that minimizes fatigue during extended sessions. The midnight‑black finish offers a sleek aesthetic, and the brush’s detachable head allows for easy cleaning and maintenance. Ideal for professional groomers and home owners alike, the Velora Velvet Shear Brush promotes healthy coat shine and skin comfort.
